item.title: Bill to lift limits on off-year legislation idled in Senate committee
item.description: As the legislative session winds down, Senate leadership has ducked debate on a proposed constitutional amendment that would have loosened restrictions on what bills may be considered during short legislation sessions — those lasting just 30 days in even-numbered years. Currently, lawmakers are restricted to bills “germane” to the budget or taxes, or named as priorities […]
